exposure: timing of cow's milk protein introduction (CMPI)
CMPI at age less than 2 weeks
CMPI at age 2 weeks to less than 6 months
CMPI at age 6 months or more
formula after delivery + CMPI at age less than 2 weeks

cohort: Children in the Boston, Mass-area Project Viva cohort
finding: Early and consistent cow's milk exposure appears protective against adverse reactions to cow's milk, particularly in children given formula after delivery.
